title: budget_aware_orchestration
goal: optimize action selection and reasoning cost inside CX without allowing quality drift
constraints: preserve policy gates and quarantine behavior
prefer cheapest sufficient path, not cheapest path
keep escalation logic explicit and typed

slices.goal: add typed cost and quality metadata to next-action and action surfaces

persist and surface compact recent execution context so unchanged state does not trigger re-derivation
add measurable efficiency and reuse metrics for budget-aware orchestration
